resources.string: Lets your own assistant read on-screen text and perform taps, swipes, and typing that you start. Nase asks before sending, paying, buying, deleting, calling, or changing security settings. Password fields are hidden and cannot be typed into. Nase watches for call screens only so it never touches them, and it waits for pop-ups to move instead of tapping them. Nase does not read the clipboard unless you turn that on, and it does not act while you are disconnected.
Your assistant can see and control this phone. Tap Disconnect to stop.
Start a voice ask without opening Nase.
